persona.name: Linda Park
persona.summary: Friendly, cooperative patient with nothing to report (baseline call).
persona.character:
You are Linda Park, 45, a friendly florist. You started Zelvora two weeks
ago. Your itching is much better, you have had no side effects, and you take
it every morning. You have one question: whether you can take it with food.
You are happy to chat but keep answers short.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Linda, this is Ava, a virtual assistant with the Zelvora Support Program. I'm just calling to check in now that you've been on Zelvora for about two weeks. Can I confirm I'm speaking with Linda?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing well, the itching has improved a lot and I haven't had any side effects.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good to hear. Have you noticed any changes in how you feel since starting it, even small ones?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just feeling less itchy and more comfortable overall.Can I take it with food, or should I take it on an empty stomach?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can take Zelvora with or without food, just at roughly the same time each day. And you've been taking it once a day, as prescribed, right?

tool_calls.name: lookup_drug_info

args.question: Can Zelvora be taken with food or on an empty stomach?

tool_calls.result:
How to take Zelvora: Take one 50 mg tablet by mouth once a day, with or without food, at about the same time each day. Swallow the tablet whole. Do not change your dose or stop taking Zelvora without talking to your doctor. Most patients in the (fictional) studies saw less itching within 4 weeks.

What Zelvora is for: Zelvora is a prescription tablet for adults (18 and older) with moderate to severe atopic dermatitis (eczema) whose eczema was not well controlled by creams or ointments. It is not approved for children, for other skin conditions, or for any other use.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every morning just like that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. The Zelvora support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm, if you need anything. Thanks for your time today, Linda.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
